print("points", m.CountPoints, "facets", m.CountFacets)
print("solid", m.isSolid())
print("volume", m.Volume, "area", m.Area)
print("components", m.countComponents())
print("nonmanifolds", m.hasNonManifolds())
print("selfintersections", m.hasSelfIntersections())

print("open edges", len(m.getNonUniformlyOrientedFacets()) if hasattr(m,"getNonUniformlyOrientedFacets") else "")
print("degenerated", m.hasNonManifoldPoints() if hasattr(m,"hasNonManifoldPoints") else "")
print("BB", m.BoundBox)
